_notes.tension_order: Head-to-toe sequence: jaw → head/temples → neck/throat → shoulders → chest/diaphragm → back → hips/pelvis → gut/abdomen → hands → feet. Matches natural body scan direction.
_notes.tension_anchor: Both szTension and szBurnout share insertAfter:vasItem_bodyTension. Injection order follows preset.addons array — szTension inserts first (immediately after core body tension), then szBurnoutPre/szWornOut follow as a capstone to the somatic inventory.
_notes.tension_labels: High anchor changed from 'Extreme' to 'Intense' — more specific to tension, avoids pain connotation.
_notes.burnout_timing: sz_managing_emotions and sz_burnout_capacity are pre-only — they measure coping capacity that doesn't shift in 15 minutes. sz_worn_out appears at both timings as fatigue is fast-moving enough to be meaningful post-session.
_notes.emotional_state_pruning: Suzanne's 10-item battery reduced to 3 novel items. Removed items fully covered by SSS or STAI-6: energetic, anxious/jittery, tired, foggy/scattered, calm/relaxed, clear/focused, tense/overwhelmed.
_notes.3day_followup: Participants instructed to return and complete a new pre-session 3 days later using same name. Identifiable in data by: pre-only session, no matched post in same session_id, timestamp ~3 days after original pair.
_notes.pii: Email, phone, date require edge function changes. Not implemented.
_notes.comment_prompts: Suzanne uses different open-ended prompts per timepoint. Per-timing comment text requires HTML change — not yet implemented.
